title: Value of a constant assignment for three-variable equations
statement: Let $V$ be a type of variables and consider a finite multiset of constraints, with at least one constraint, in which every variable occurs in some constraint. Each constraint selects an ordered triple of distinct variables and requires their sum in the field with two elements to equal a specified element of that field. Choose the constant assignment, giving every variable the same field element, whose instance value is larger (choosing the assignment with value $1$ in case of a tie). Its fraction of satisfied constraints is at least $1/2$.
hypotheses_covered: The instance uses the three-variable linear-equation template over the field with two elements
